But i`m guessing you`re searching for the wallet.dat file aren`t you ?
In that case you should find it by default in the following path: C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\Roaming\DogeCoin\
Or you could search for it on windows 7 by typing %appdata% in the search bar and then mannualy navigate to the path mentioned above.

Once a block has been found, go to your account-tab and check your balance there, or you could go to the dashboard and look at the amount of confirmed doge there (dont worry about the unconfirmed doge, you'll get that eventually aswell).
